intuition: Roman numerals use a fixed descending set of additive values and six subtractive forms.

brute_force.approach: Convert each decimal digit position using separate lookup tables for thousands, hundreds, tens, and ones.

optimal.approach: Greedily emit each descending Roman value as many times as it fits, including subtractive pairs.

edge_cases: The range is 1 through 3999, so at most three M symbols are needed.
Subtractive values must be considered before their additive components.
The greedy order yields the canonical numeral.
